tickets.name: Win the Tip
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for Hornets at Wizards, because the first minute is where the money is! It starts with Davis against Diabate at center court, and our money says Davis gets up there first! Win that tip and the Wizards are first in line to score. The Wizards' first set runs through Sarr, and he's got the green light shining bright! The Hornets get a stop? Then it's Reid running the other way for the first two! Every one of our picks is a way to win the opening bucket, and every one of them cashes!

tickets.name: Tip Drill
